description: Starts a flow on a conversation, as the thread's flow picker does: flowId names an active flow (read entity flows); its steps become tasks with deadlines. label is optional. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: start_conversation_flow
title: Start a flow on a conversation
